method: Current primary Google documentation plus public search-result observations. The existing signed-in Cloudflare request and visitor dashboards were inspected read-only. No account identifiers, client IPs, raw telemetry or account screenshots are included in this public artifact.
trafficFinding: The Cloudflare dashboards include named crawlers and GetMacros verification traffic. Their request counts and IP-based unique visitor labels do not establish human organic search demand. No Search Console query, impression, click or CTR report was available in this review. No keyword volumes or traffic forecasts are claimed.
